title: Manyhands JSON v1 conflicted path
description: One path of a live synchronization conflict: how to show it, the token that names it to a resolution, what it holds, and its three sides when it is an item's canonical text.

display_path.description: The path for display: each byte outside printable ASCII as \xNN, and a backslash doubled. It is never a writable path.

token.description: conflict-path-v1: and a digest that binds the path to the observation. It is re-derived on every read and is valid only while the conflict is unchanged.

kind.description: What the path holds: an item's canonical source, or content that is no canonical item.

structure.description: The shape of the path's sides. Only regular canonical content can be resolved in Manyhands; incompatible_closures is a ticket the two sides closed differently.

content_available.description: Whether the sides are given: only for a path whose kind is an item (document, ticket or comment), whatever its structure, when the library reads them as text. A path of kind noncanonical, text or not, is given none. When false, base, local and incoming are null.

base.description: The merge base's side, or null when it has none or it is not read.

local.description: The local branch's side, or null when it has none or it is not read.

incoming.description: The incoming side, or null when it has none or it is not read.
